name: Making models smaller and faster
gist: These papers shrink neural networks and reduce computation by removing unneeded weights, simplifying math, or using lower precision numbers while keeping the model smart.
explain: The straightforward idea: not all weights matter equally. A neural network with one million weights might be able to throw away half of them and barely lose any accuracy. These papers figure out which weights are least important, then remove them. Some look at which weights are closest to zero. Others measure how much each weight actually changes the output. Once you remove them, the network is smaller, uses less memory, and runs faster — because there is literally less math to do.

The tricky part is that removing weights is not smooth. If you just cut out the weak ones, you often get big gaps in accuracy. So researchers do this gradually, or they retrain the network a little bit after pruning to let the remaining weights learn to compensate. Another angle is quantization: instead of using full-precision numbers (which take lots of memory), use smaller numbers — fewer bits — that take less space. An 8-bit number is half the size of a 16-bit number, which cuts memory in half. The catch is that smaller numbers cannot hold as much detail, so you have to be clever about which layers get the aggressive cuts.

A third direction combines both: start with a large network, train it, prune it, quantize it, and sometimes add clever tricks like knowledge distillation — having a smaller network learn from a larger one to capture its knowledge without the bulk. The papers in this subtheme measure speed and accuracy against each other, finding the right tradeoffs for different devices and tasks.

papers.title: ARMOR: High-Performance Semi-Structured Pruning via Adaptive Matrix Factorization
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art 2:4 pruning on Llama and Qwen models; generalizes to N:M patterns and unstructured sparsity while retaining inference speedups.

papers.title: DTO-KD: Dynamic Trade-off Optimization for Effective Knowledge Distillation
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms prior KD methods on ImageNet-1K and COCO, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy with improved convergence behavior.

papers.title: Distillation of Large Language Models via Concrete Score Matching
papers.contribution: Consistently surpasses recent KD objectives across task-agnostic, task-specific, and chat capability distillation with favorable fidelity-diversity trade-offs and complementary gains with on-policy techniques.

papers.title: DynamicInfer: Runtime-Aware Sparse Offloading for LLMs Inference on a Consumer-Grade GPU
papers.contribution: Achieves 253% speedup over llama.cpp and 59% over PowerInfer while retaining model accuracy on resource-constrained devices.

papers.title: LeSTD: LLM Compression via Learning-based Sparse Tensor Decomposition
papers.contribution: LeSTD breaks the compression ceiling imposed by dense cores, enabling significantly higher compression ratios than prior tensor decomposition methods.

papers.title: LogART: Pushing the Limit of Efficient Logarithmic Post-Training Quantization
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on various architectures and ultra-low bitwidths; outperforms existing logarithmic PTQ methods while maintaining efficiency.

papers.title: MaskPro: Linear-Space Probabilistic Learning for Strict (N:M)-Sparsity on LLMs
papers.contribution: Demonstrates superior performance with excellent scalability in memory efficiency and robustness to data samples for (N:M)-sparsity on LLMs.

papers.title: MoNE: Replacing Redundant Experts with Lightweight Novices for Structured Pruning of MoE
papers.contribution: Outperforms baselines by up to 2.72 average zero-shot accuracy across nine tasks at 25% pruning ratio with only 0.14 performance drop on Qwen2-57B-A14B.

papers.title: QVGen: Pushing the Limit of Quantized Video Generative Models
papers.contribution: First to reach full-precision comparable quality under 4-bit settings on state-of-the-art video DMs (1.3B-14B parameters), with 3-bit CogVideoX-2B achieving +25.28 improvement.

papers.title: QuantSparse: Comprehensively Compressing Video Diffusion Transformer with Model Quantization and Attention Sparsification
papers.contribution: QuantSparse on HunyuanVideo-13B achieves 20.88 PSNR with 3.68× storage reduction and 1.88× inference acceleration, substantially outperforming the quantization baseline Q-VDiT.

papers.title: Reassessing Layer Pruning in LLMs: New Insights and Methods
papers.contribution: Surpasses existing state-of-the-art pruning methods by 5.62%-17.27% on Llama-3.1-8B-It, 2.36%-19.45% on Llama-3-8B and 4.34%-9.59% on Llama-3-70B.

papers.title: Vulcan: Crafting Compact Class-Specific Vision Transformers For Edge Intelligence
papers.contribution: Derives compact class-specific ViTs that significantly reduce size and computation while even surpassing original ViT performance on target classes.

papers.title: WSVD: Weighted Low-Rank Approximation for Fast and Efficient Execution of Low-Precision Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Achieved over 1.8x decoding speedup on VLMs while preserving accuracy performance through weighted, quantized SVD.

papers.title: Why Low-Precision Transformer Training Fails: An Analysis on Flash Attention
papers.contribution: Our fix mitigates bias in rounding errors, stabilizing low-precision training and confirming our analysis of the underlying failure mechanism.

papers.title: A Robust Optimization Guided Pruning Framework for Vision and Large Language Models
papers.contribution: RobOP offers improvements over prior pruning approaches by explicitly accounting for uncertainty; scales to large vision and language models.

papers.title: A3: an Analytical Low-Rank Approximation Framework for Attention
papers.contribution: LLaMA 3.1-70B low-rank approximation achieves 4.69 perplexity on WikiText-2, outperforming sota 7.87; versatile applications in KV cache compression and quantization integration.

papers.title: AGoQ: Activation and Gradient Quantization for Memory-Efficient Distributed Training of LLMs
papers.contribution: Reduces memory by up to 52% and achieves up to 1.34× training speedup compared to Megatron-LM, COAT, and DeepSpeed on 8B-32B models.

papers.title: AIRE-Prune: Asymptotic Impulse-Response Energy for State Pruning in State Space Models
papers.contribution: Achieves average 60.8% state pruning with only 0.29% accuracy drop without retraining on diverse sequence benchmarks, significantly lowering compute.

papers.title: ASTRA: Communication-Efficient Acceleration for Multi-Device Transformer Inference
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 2.64× speedup and 15.25× over prior baselines while operating at bandwidths as low as 10 Mbps.

papers.title: Absorbing Quantization Error by Deformable Noise Scheduler for Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: Plug-and-play approach complements PTQ schemes; reduces FID from 27.16 to 26.22 with fully integer inference.

papers.title: Achieving low-bit Muon through subspace preservation and grid quantization
papers.contribution: Achieves accuracy comparable to full-precision while reducing training memory consumption by up to 28% on LLaMA pre-training and fine-tuning tasks.

papers.title: AdaRank: Adaptive Rank Pruning for Enhanced Model Merging
papers.contribution: Consistently improves merging across diverse backbones and modalities, narrowing performance gap against individually fine-tuned models.

papers.title: Adaptive Nonlinear Compression for Large Foundation Models
papers.contribution: Demonstrates superior compression performance on LLMs and vision models across datasets while achieving higher compression ratios than existing methods.

papers.title: Adaptive Visual Autoregressive Acceleration via Dual-Linkage Entropy Analysis
papers.contribution: NOVA is training-free and maintains generation quality while accelerating inference for VAR models.

papers.title: Adaptive Width Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Shows width adapts to task difficulty with easy truncation at zero cost, enabling smooth performance-compute trade-off or dynamic compression without performance degradation.

papers.title: AnyBCQ: Hardware Efficient Flexible Binary-Coded Quantization for Multi-Precision LLMs
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 3.0x throughput gains over half precision and 1.2x over state-of-the-art methods while remaining competitive across precision levels.

papers.title: Attention Sparsity is Input-Stable: Training-Free Sparse Attention for Video Generation via Offline Sparsity Profiling and Online QK Co-Clus
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 1.93x speedup maintaining PSNR up to 29 dB across seven video generation models outperforming state-of-the-art.

papers.title: Attn-QAT: 4-Bit Attention With Quantization-Aware Training
papers.contribution: Recovers quality from FP4 attention without explicit outlier-mitigation heuristics and delivers up to 1.5x speedup on RTX 5090 across diffusion and language models.

papers.title: Attribution-Guided and Coverage-Maximized Pruning for Structural MoE Compression
papers.contribution: Retains accuracy under 50% or 25% pruning with 4-bit quantization, reducing Qwen3-30B-A3B memory footprint by 5.27x.

papers.title: AutoQVLA: Not All Channels Are Equal in Vision-Language-Action Model's Quantization
papers.contribution: Requires only 29.2% of original VRAM while maintaining 98.9% performance and achieving 1.49x speedup on LIBERO.

papers.title: Automatic Pruning Discovery for Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Overcomes expert knowledge requirements and outlier value problem; consistently excels on mainstream LLM benchmarks without manual algorithm design.

papers.title: BBQ: Boosting Quantization Entropy with Bell Box Quantization
papers.contribution: BBQ outperforms prior SOTA by perplexity reductions: 2 points (4-bit), 4 points (3-bit), 5 points (2-bit), and 18 points (1-bit models).

papers.title: BLADE: Block-Sparse Attention Meets Step Distillation for Efficient Video Generation
papers.contribution: BLADE achieves 14.10x end-to-end inference acceleration on Wan2.1-1.3B and 8.89x speedup on CogVideoX-5B with consistent quality maintenance.

papers.title: BPDQ: Bit-Plane Decomposition Quantization on a Variable Grid for Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Enables serving Qwen2.5-72B on single RTX 3090 with 83.85% GSM8K accuracy at 2-bit.

papers.title: Batch Pruning by Activation Stability
papers.contribution: Reduces training batch usage by up to 57% with no accuracy loss and achieves 61% savings in GPU node-hours while outperforming prior pruning methods.

papers.title: Beyond Hamming: Query-Aware Decoding of Binary Cosine Sketches
papers.contribution: QA-Cos reduces estimation error by 15-20% in near-orthogonal region, improving Hit@K by ~30 percentage points at fixed budgets and reducing candidates by 45-50% at fixed recall in two-stage ANN pipelines.

papers.title: Beyond Tokens: Enhancing RTL Quality Estimation via Structural Graph Learning
papers.contribution: StructRTL establishes new state-of-the-art results on RTL quality estimation tasks, significantly outperforming prior art through structural learning with cross-stage supervision.

papers.title: Beyond Uniformity: Sample and Frequency Meta Weighting for Post-Training Quantization of Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art PTQ methods on CIFAR-10, LSUN-Bedrooms, FFHQ, and ImageNet by selectively focusing on frequency components and sample importance at each timestep.

papers.title: Block Rotation is All You Need for MXFP4 Quantization
papers.contribution: Provides first in-depth analysis of rotation-based quantization incompatibility with MXFP4 and achieves substantial accuracy improvements across diverse LLMs through block rotation adaptation.

papers.title: Boomerang Distillation Enables Zero-Shot Model Size Interpolation
papers.contribution: Boomerang distillation generates zero-shot fine-grained model families whose performance scales smoothly between student and teacher, often matching or surpassing independently trained models of the same size.

papers.title: Bridging the Gap Between Promise and Performance for FP4 Quantization
papers.contribution: Achieves speedups up to 3.6x layer-wise on NVIDIA B200 and 6x on RTX5090 with accuracy matching or outperforming state-of-the-art.

papers.title: Bring Future Vision: Dynamic Computation Allocation Guided by Lightweight Feature Forecaster
papers.contribution: Informed routing achieves state-of-the-art performance across static and dynamic pruning with practical speedups via PyTorch and Triton implementations.

papers.title: CAT-Q: Cost-efficient and Accurate Ternary Quantization for LLMs
papers.contribution: CAT-Q achieves superior performance than BitNet v1/v2 trained with 100B tokens using 100,000× fewer training tokens; scales to 235B parameters within 60 hours.

papers.title: CGSVD: Cascaded Granular Singular Value Decomposition for Large Language Model Compression
papers.contribution: On LLaMA3.1-8B at 30% compression, CGSVD achieves 6.08% average zero-shot accuracy boost and 15.46 perplexity reduction vs. baseline SVD compression.

papers.title: Channel-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient Long-Context Inference
papers.contribution: Achieves at least 5 percentage points improvement over baseline methods on RULER benchmark, enabling 2.3x increase in batch size and 1.5x longer context during inference.

papers.title: CoCoQuant: Breaking the Bandwidth Wall via Co-Optimized Communication and Computation Quantization
papers.contribution: Achieves Pareto-optimal accuracy-latency trade-offs with up to 2.92x end-to-end speedup and 0.22 perplexity increase on LLMs of varying scales.

papers.title: CodeQuant: Unified Clustering and Quantization for Enhanced Outlier Smoothing in Low-Precision Mixture-of-Experts
papers.contribution: CodeQuant achieves up to 4.15x speedup with significantly higher accuracy than state-of-the-art quantization across diverse MoE models.

papers.title: CollectiveKV: Decoupling and Sharing Collaborative Information in Sequential Recommendation
papers.contribution: Compresses KV cache to 0.8% of original size while maintaining or enhancing model performance across five recommendation models and three datasets.

papers.title: Compute Where it Counts: Self Optimizing Language Models
papers.contribution: Improves quality at matched budget over static allocation and strong random schedule search, offering a complementary axis for inference-efficiency optimization.

papers.title: Compute-Optimal Quantization-Aware Training
papers.contribution: A derived loss scaling law predicts both optimal QAT ratios and final model performance, and a cooldown-QAT fusion approach achieves significant compute savings.

papers.title: Condition Number Based Low-Bit Quantization for Image Super-Resolution
papers.contribution: Outperforms existing post-training quantization methods without computation overhead and achieves theoretically optimal compression ratio in model parameters.

papers.title: Consistency Deep Equilibrium Models
papers.contribution: Achieves 2-20× accuracy improvements over implicit DEQs under same few-step budget; facilitates flexible multi-step evaluation to trade computation for performance.

papers.title: CriticalKV: Optimizing KV Cache Eviction from an Output Perturbation Perspective
papers.contribution: A plug-and-play algorithm that reduces compression loss by more than half on average across 29 datasets when integrated with state-of-the-art cache eviction methods on three LLMs.

papers.title: Cross-Tokenizer Likelihood Scoring Algorithms for Language Model Distillation
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 12% reduction in memory footprint for Qwen2.5-1.5B and 4% performance improvement on distillation tasks, with 2% improvement on GSM8K reasoning.

papers.title: Cut Less, Fold More: Model Compression through the Lens of Projection Geometry
papers.contribution: Empirical evaluation on >1000 checkpoints across ResNet18, ViT-B/32, and CLIP shows folding typically achieves higher accuracy at moderate-high compression with gains diminishing at extreme compression.

papers.title: DLLMQuant: A Post-Training Quantization Framework Tailored for Diffusion-Based Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Tailored quantization framework for diffusion LLMs addressing unique challenges unaddressed by standard PTQ methods.

papers.title: DOT-MoE: Differentiable Optimal Transport for MoEfication
papers.contribution: DOT-MoE retains 90% of dense model performance while reducing active parameters by 50%, outperforming structured pruning and heuristic clustering baselines.

papers.title: DPQuant: Efficient and Private Model Training via Dynamic Quantization Scheduling
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 2.21× theoretical throughput improvements on low-precision hardware with less than 2% accuracy drop while maintaining differential privacy.

papers.title: DTP: Delta-Guided Two Stage Pruning for Mamba-based Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Reduces computation by nearly 50%, maintains higher performance than existing pruning methods, and achieves over 35% prefill latency reduction.

papers.title: Demystifying When Pruning Works via Representation Hierarchies
papers.contribution: Shows stability of embedding and logit spaces enables pruning for retrieval/classification but probability-space amplification degrades generation; provides practical pruning guidance.

papers.title: Diffusion LLMs Can Do Faster-Than-AR Inference via Discrete Diffusion Forcing
papers.contribution: D2F dLLMs achieve 2.5× inference speedup over LLaMA3 and Qwen2.5, and 50× acceleration over vanilla diffusion LLMs like LLaDA and Dream while maintaining output quality.

papers.title: Dirichlet-Prior Shaping: Guiding Expert Specialization in Upcycled MoEs
papers.contribution: Shows that DPSL consistently outperforms existing upcycling strategies on vision-language benchmarks by enhancing expert specialization without manual intervention.

papers.title: Dissecting Quantization Error: A Concentration-Alignment Perspective
papers.contribution: CAT consistently matches or outperforms prior transform-based quantization methods at 4-bit precision across several LLMs.

papers.title: Drop-in Circulant Structural Priors for Transformer Decoding of Cyclic Codes
papers.contribution: Achieves average bit error rate reduction by an order of magnitude while reducing parameters by approximately 97% compared to standard Transformer decoders.

papers.title: ECO: Quantized Training without Full-Precision Master Weights
papers.contribution: ECO matches baseline accuracy with master weights while achieving near-lossless performance on 30M-2.1B models and DeepSeek-MoE-16B fine-tuning, significantly shifting the memory-accuracy Pareto frontier.

papers.title: Effective Distillation to Hybrid xLSTM Architectures
papers.contribution: xLSTM students recover most of teacher performance and sometimes exceed it on downstream tasks, advancing energy-efficient and cost-effective alternatives to transformer LLMs.

papers.title: Effective Model Pruning : Measuring the Redundancy of Model Components
papers.contribution: Provides universal adaptive threshold with provable upper bound on loss change relative to original model across MLPs, CNNs, Transformers, LLMs, and KAN architectures.

papers.title: Efficient Learned Image Compression without Entropy Coding
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 67.86% bitrate reduction over MS-ILLM on Kodak with LPIPS while enabling 3× faster encoding and 5× faster decoding than entropy-coding variants.

papers.title: Efficient Multi-modal Dataset Distillation via Analytic Parameter Matching
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 65x storage reduction and 9.6x faster distillation while scaling to 1,000 synthetic pairs, with notable generalization in cross-architecture and zero-shot settings.

papers.title: Efficient Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts with Theoretical Generalization Guarantees
papers.contribution: Achieves higher accuracy than existing quantization methods on large-scale MoE models including Switch Transformer and Mixtral, reducing inference cost with negligible bit-width assignment overhead.

papers.title: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Hierarchical Search and Self-Verification for Discrete Diffusion Language Models
papers.contribution: Matches best-of-N performance with substantially fewer function evaluations across four reasoning and code generation benchmarks.

papers.title: Eigenvectors of Experts are Training-free Non-collapsing Routers
papers.contribution: Provides a novel training-free framework that addresses expert collapse and enhances model performance with strong generalization and robustness across diverse language and vision tasks.

papers.title: Ensembling Pruned Attention Heads For Uncertainty-Aware Efficient Transformers
papers.contribution: Hydra Ensembles matches or surpasses Deep Ensembles in uncertainty quantification performance with inference speed near a single network, including state-of-the-art results on ImageNet-1k zero-shot classification.

papers.title: Equilibrium Language Models
papers.contribution: Prunes 28% of parameters while retaining 99% accuracy, establishing a new direction for edge-deployable large models.

papers.title: Error Propagation Mechanisms and Compensation Strategies for Quantized Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: Achieves 1.2 PSNR improvement over SVDQuant on SDXL W4A4 with less than 0.5% time overhead.

papers.title: FAIR-Calib: Frontier-Aware Instability-Reweighted Calibration for Post-Training Quantization of Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms baselines on LLaDA and Dream (W4A4), significantly reducing frontier flips and post-commit mismatches.

papers.title: FASA: FREQUENCY-AWARE SPARSE ATTENTION
papers.contribution: FASA reaches nearly 100% of full-KV performance when keeping only 256 tokens and achieves 2.56× speedup using just 18.9% of the cache on AIME24.

papers.title: FOCUS & RePAIR: Mitigating Text Degeneration via Token-Level Guidance For Pruned Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Consistently reduces repetition and improves generation quality across open-ended and instruction-based generation.

papers.title: FPTQuant: Function-Preserving Transforms for LLM Quantization
papers.contribution: FPTQuant enables static INT4 quantization with 3.9× speedup over FP and performance matching most prior work without custom kernels.

papers.title: Fast and Accurate Causal Parallel Decoding using Jacobi Forcing
papers.contribution: Achieves 3.8× wall-clock speedup with minimal performance loss and up to 4.6× token acceptance rate improvement through multi-block decoding with rejection recycling.

papers.title: Fast-SAM3D: 3Dfy Anything in Images but Faster
papers.contribution: Fast-SAM3D delivers up to 2.67× end-to-end speedup with negligible fidelity loss on single-view 3D generation.

papers.title: Faster Than Flash: Exploiting Attention Sparsity for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
papers.contribution: Achieves 11.6x kernel-level speedup at 256k context length and 2.37x end-to-end throughput improvement while maintaining accuracy.

papers.title: FasterVAR: Plug-and-Play Acceleration for Visual Autoregressive Models
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 3.4x speedup with almost no performance loss, consistently outperforming acceleration baselines on VAR models.

papers.title: FedCDWA: Decoupled Federated Prototype Distillation with Hierarchical Wasserstein Aggregation
papers.contribution: Improves both global and personalized accuracy with smaller performance degradation under severe heterogeneity.

papers.title: Fine-tuning Quantized Neural Networks with Zeroth-order Optimization
papers.contribution: QZO reduces total memory cost by more than 18x for 4-bit LLMs and enables fine-tuning Llama-2-13B within a single 24GB GPU.

papers.title: FlashOptim: Optimizers for Memory-Efficient Training
papers.contribution: Reduces AdamW memory from 16 to 7 bytes per parameter (5 with gradient release), cuts checkpoint sizes by half, and reduces model checkpoint sizes without quality degradation.

papers.title: FlexHiNM-GP: Flexible Hierarchical Pruning via Region Allocation and Channel Permutation
papers.contribution: Consistently surpasses structured baselines and approaches unstructured pruning performance on vision and language benchmarks.

papers.title: Float8@2bits: Entropy Coding Enables Data-Free Model Compression
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art results on standard benchmarks and instruction-tuned models while retaining functional performance at modest inference overhead.

papers.title: FourTune: Towards Fully 4-Bit Efficient Post-Training for Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: Matches full-precision fine-tuning quality on customization, RL, and distillation tasks; on FLUX.1-dev reduces memory by 2.25x and increases throughput by 2.27x versus BF16 LoRA.

papers.title: From Per-Image Low-Rank to Encoding Mismatch: Rethinking Feature Distillation in Vision Transformers
papers.contribution: Revives feature KD for ViT compression, improving DeiT-Tiny distilled from CaiT-S24 from 74.86% to 77.53%/78.23% top-1 accuracy.

papers.title: GAPrune: Gradient-Alignment Pruning for Domain-Aware Embeddings
papers.contribution: Maintains within 2.5% of dense model performance at 50% sparsity with one-shot pruning and improves 4.51% on FinMTEB and 1.73% on ChemTEB with 100 retraining steps.

papers.title: GEMQ: Global Expert-Level Mixed-Precision Quantization for MoE LLMs
papers.contribution: We significantly reduce memory and accelerate inference with minimal accuracy degradation through iterative refinement of importance estimation.

papers.title: GHOST: Unmasking Phantom States in Mamba2 via Grouped Hidden-state Output-aware Selection & Truncation
papers.contribution: 50% state-dimension reduction with ~1 perplexity point increase on WikiText-2; rivals gradient-based methods without backprop.

papers.title: GPTailor: Large Language Model Pruning Through Layer Cutting and Stitching
papers.contribution: For Llama2-13B, maintains approximately 97.3% of original performance while removing ~25% of parameters, significantly outperforming previous state-of-the-art pruning methods.

papers.title: GSRQ: Gain-Shape Residual Quantization for Sub-1-bit KV Cache
papers.contribution: GSRQ improves 1-bit KV cache from 11.34 to 33.54 accuracy on LongBench tasks, a 22.20 percentage point gain over VQLLM.

papers.title: Gated Relational Alignment via Confidence-based Distillation for Efficient VLMs
papers.contribution: INT4 models consistently outperform FP16 baselines (e.g., LLaVA-1.5-7B: 70.1 vs 66.8 on SQA) achieving 3× throughput with 54% memory reduction.

papers.title: GlowQ: Group-Shared LOw-Rank Approximation for Quantized LLMs
papers.contribution: Reduces TTFB by 5.6% and increases throughput by 9.6%, reduces perplexity on WikiText-2 by 0.17%, and selective variant cuts TTFB by 23.4%.

papers.title: Gradient Transformer: Learning to Generate Updates for LLMs
papers.contribution: Remarkably outperforms knowledge distillation baselines on language modeling and reasoning tasks while maintaining strict differential privacy protection.

papers.title: Grouter: Decoupling Routing from Representation for Accelerated MoE Training
papers.contribution: Achieves superior performance and efficiency with 4.28x boost in data utilization and up to 33.5% throughput acceleration.

papers.title: HEAPr: Hessian-based Efficient Atomic Expert Pruning in Output Space
papers.contribution: Achieves nearly lossless compression on MoE models including DeepSeek MoE and Qwen MoE family across a wide range of compression ratios.

papers.title: HiDivDrop: Vision Token Reduction in MLLMs via Late Injection and Differentiable Top-K
papers.contribution: Compresses ~90% of vision tokens while matching original performance and accelerating training by 1.72x.

papers.title: High-Fidelity ANN-to-SNN Conversion via Closed-Loop CKA Distillation
papers.contribution: Achieves over 99% of source ANN accuracy at T=32 and produces SNNs with input noise robustness matching or exceeding source ANNs.

papers.title: Highly Efficient and Effective LLMs with Multi-Boolean Architectures
papers.contribution: The method outperforms recent ultra low-bit quantization and binarization techniques across diverse LLMs.

papers.title: INT vs. FP: A Comprehensive Study of Fine-Grained Low-bit Quantization Formats
papers.contribution: Demonstrates MXINT8 and MXINT4 superior to FP counterparts in accuracy and hardware efficiency, challenging current hardware trajectories.

papers.title: Improving Block-Wise LLM Quantization by 4-bit Block-Wise Optimal Float (BOF4): Analysis and Variations
papers.contribution: BOF4-S consistently reduces quantization error compared to NF4 and AF4 with mixed-precision strategy (OPQ) achieving top performance in 4-bit block-wise quantization.

papers.title: Is Finer Better? The Limits of Microscaling Formats in Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Identifies and explains anomalous microscaling behavior through interplay between narrow tensor distributions and limited dynamic range, proposing practical hardware-friendly solution.

papers.title: KBVQ-MoE: KLT-guided SVD with Bias-Corrected Vector Quantization for MoE Large Language Models
papers.contribution: The method enables extremely low-bit quantization for MoE-based LLMs with negligible computational and memory overhead.

papers.title: KDP: Simplifying Representation Dynamics in Kernel Space
papers.contribution: Both theoretical analysis and extensive experiments validate KDP's effectiveness and superiority over existing pruning baselines.

papers.title: KV-Cache Transform Coding for Compact Storage in LLM Inference
papers.contribution: KVTC achieves up to 20x compression while maintaining accuracy on reasoning and long-context tasks across Llama 3.1, Mistral-NeMo, and R1-Qwen 2.5.

papers.title: KernelBand: Steering LLM-based Kernel Optimization via Hardware-Aware Multi-Armed Bandits
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms strongest agent baseline, achieving up to 1.91× geometric mean speedup with 39-140% relative improvement in Fast@1 success rate across three GPU architectures.

papers.title: LATMiX: Learnable Affine Transformations for Microscaling Quantization of LLMs
papers.contribution: Consistent improvements in average accuracy for MX low-bit quantization over strong baselines across model sizes with theoretical quantization error bounds.

papers.title: LC-QAT: Data-Efficient 2-Bit QAT for LLMs via Linear-Constrained Vector Quantization
papers.contribution: LC-QAT outperforms state-of-the-art QAT methods using only 0.1-10% training data across diverse LLMs.

papers.title: LFQ: Logit-aware Final-block Quantization for Boosting the Generation Quality of Low-Bit Quantized LLMs
papers.contribution: Consistently improves accuracy on complex generation tasks while maintaining parity with FP baselines on language modeling and understanding.

papers.title: LLaVA-FA: Learning Fourier Approximation for Compressing Large Multimodal Models
papers.contribution: Outperforms existing efficient multimodal models while maintaining minimal activated parameters and low computational costs.

papers.title: LSA: Layer-wise Sparsity Allocation for Large Language Model Pruning Based on Minimal Linear Reconstruction Error
papers.contribution: At 70% overall sparsity, LSA surpasses state-of-the-art methods across language modeling and seven zero-shot tasks while supporting flexible per-block pruning.

papers.title: Large Language Model Compression with Global Rank and Sparsity Optimization
papers.contribution: Automatically detects layer redundancy and manages sparse-rank interaction, significantly surpassing state-of-the-art sparsification and approximation techniques.

papers.title: Learnable Sparsity for Vision Generative Models
papers.contribution: Our method efficiently prunes 20% of parameters from SDXL and FLUX models in just 10 A100 GPU hours, outperforming previous pruning approaches with minimal retraining cost.

papers.title: Learning Semi-Structured Sparsity for LLMs via Shared and Context-Aware Hypernetwork
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art accuracy-sparsity trade-offs on LLaMA 7B-70B with higher efficiency, accuracy, and scalability than prior approaches.

papers.title: Less Precise Can Be More Reliable: A Systematic Evaluation of Quantization’s Impact on VLMs Beyond Accuracy
papers.contribution: Quantization can simultaneously improve accuracy, calibration, OOD detection, and noise robustness in VLMs, enabling deployment of faster, more reliable models.

papers.title: LiftQuant: Continuous Bit-Width LLM via Dimensional Lifting and Projection
papers.contribution: Enables 70B LLM compression to 2.4 bits for 24GB GPU with performance significantly surpassing standard 2-bit models.

papers.title: Lightweight Spatio-Temporal Modeling via Temporally Shifted Distillation for Real-Time Accident Anticipation
papers.contribution: The method achieves state-of-the-art on dashcam benchmarks while being 3-7x smaller than leading approaches and running real-time on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano.

papers.title: LittleBit-2: Maximizing the Spectral Energy Gain in Sub-1-Bit LLMs via Latent Geometry Alignment
papers.contribution: LittleBit-2 establishes new state-of-the-art in sub-1-bit regime (1~0.1 bpp) on Llama-2 and Llama-3, matching fidelity of leading 1-bit baselines.

papers.title: Log-Normal Multiplicative Dynamics for Stable Low-Precision Deep Learning
papers.contribution: Successfully trains Vision Transformers and GPT-2 from scratch with low-precision forward-pass multiplications.

papers.title: M+Adam: Low-Precision Training via Additive–Multiplicative Optimization
papers.contribution: Consistently improves low-precision training across LLaMA-style pretraining with 60M–1B models using only BF16, FP8, and FP4.

papers.title: MACKO: Sparse matrix-vector multiplication for low sparsity
papers.contribution: MACKO achieves 1.5× memory reduction and 1.2-1.5× speedup at 50% sparsity compared to dense baselines, making unstructured pruning practical and bridging the gap with structured 2:4 sparsity.

papers.title: MOSS: Efficient and Accurate FP8 LLM Training with Microscaling and Automatic Scaling
papers.contribution: Enables efficient FP8 training of 7B models achieving performance comparable to BF16 baseline with up to 34% higher training throughput.

papers.title: Many Eyes, One Mind: Temporal Multi-Perspective and Progressive Distillation for Spiking Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks by providing more reliable inference across all timesteps through temporally-aligned knowledge transfer.

papers.title: Metis: Training LLMs with FP4 Quantization
papers.contribution: Metis enables robust W4A4G4 FP4 training of LLaMA-3 8B with only 0.4% training loss gap and 0.1% downstream accuracy degradation relative to BF16.

papers.title: Mitigating Error Propagation in Low-Rank Approximation of Large Models via Distribution-Aware Whitening
papers.contribution: Achieves tighter control over layerwise distortion in post-training compression and serves as effective initialization for LoRA-style parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

papers.title: MixFP4: Enhancing NVFP4 with Adaptive FP4/INT4 Block Representations
papers.contribution: MixFP4 improves FP4 quantization robustness over NVFP4 with modest overhead (3.1% area, 1.5% power) across LLM families.

papers.title: Model-Preserving Adaptive Rounding
papers.contribution: YAQA reduces error by approximately 30% over GPTQ/LDLQ and achieves lower error than quantization-aware training while adding no inference overhead.

papers.title: NanoFLUX: Distillation-Driven Compression of Large Text-to-Image Generation Models for Mobile Devices
papers.contribution: NanoFLUX generates 512x512 images in approximately 2.5 seconds on mobile devices while preserving high visual quality from large-scale models.

papers.title: NanoQuant: Efficient Sub-1-Bit Quantization of Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Achieves new Pareto frontier in post-training quantization, compressing Llama-2-70B by 24x in 13 hours on single H100, enabling 70B models on consumer 8GB GPUs.

papers.title: NanoSpec: Accelerating Speculative Decoding using Minimalist In-Context Vocabularies
papers.contribution: NanoSpec cuts draft time by 51.6% on average, delivering 1.17x-1.29x end-to-end speedup over state-of-the-art speculative decoding methods EAGLE-2 and EAGLE-3.

papers.title: NeUQI: Near-Optimal Uniform Quantization Parameter Initialization for Low-Bit LLMs
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms existing PTQ methods on LLaMA and Qwen families, and achieves superior performance to PV-tuning when combined with lightweight distillation.

papers.title: Neodragon: Mobile Video Generation Using Diffusion Transformer
papers.contribution: Generates 49 frames at 640x1024 resolution in 7.6 seconds on Qualcomm Hexagon NPU with VBench score of 81.61, setting state-of-the-art for mobile video generation.

papers.title: No Retraining at Edge: Efficient Resource-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization via Federated Supernet Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive accuracy with significantly reduced computational cost, enabling retraining-free deployment for dynamic edge computing environments.

papers.title: No outlier channels but with outlier blocks
papers.contribution: The approach avoids costly Hessian computation and fine-tuning while offering strong scalability across multiple tasks and model series.

papers.title: OBCache: Optimal Brain KV Cache Pruning for Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.contribution: Improves long-context accuracy on LLaMA and Qwen models by replacing heuristic scores with output-aware signals.

papers.title: OBS-Diff: Accurate Pruning For Diffusion Models in One-Shot
papers.contribution: OBS-Diff achieves state-of-the-art one-shot pruning with minimal visual quality degradation for diverse sparsity types on large-scale text-to-image models.

papers.title: OSAQ: Outlier Self-Absorption for Accurate Low-bit LLM Quantization
papers.contribution: OSAQ effectively suppresses outliers and improves low-bit quantization performance through closed-form offline computation with no inference overhead.

papers.title: OmniSIFT: Modality-Asymmetric Token Compression for Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Models
papers.contribution: With only 25% of original token context and 4.85M added parameters, consistently outperforms compression baselines and surpasses full-token model on several tasks for Qwen2.5-Omni-7B.

papers.title: Optimal Brain Restoration for Joint Quantization and Sparsification of LLMs
papers.contribution: Achieves only 1.4 perplexity degradation on Llama2-7B with W4A4KV4 quantization and 50% sparsity, delivering up to 4.72x speedup and 6.4x memory reduction compared to FP16-dense baseline.

papers.title: PADD: Path-Aligned Decompression Distillation for Non-Router Teacher to Guide MoE Student Learning
papers.contribution: Yields substantial gains over strong baselines where MoE students match or surpass dense teachers at the same inference cost.

papers.title: PINE: Pruning Boosted Tree Ensembles with Conformal In-Distribution Prediction Equivalence
papers.contribution: Improves compression ratio by up to 30% while maintaining prediction fidelity comparable to existing faithful pruning methods.

papers.title: PM-KVQ: Progressive Mixed-precision KV Cache Quantization for Long-CoT LLMs
papers.contribution: Addresses cumulative error and short-context calibration issues, enabling efficient KV Cache quantization for long-CoT LLMs.

papers.title: PT$^2$-LLM: Post-Training Ternarization for Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Delivers competitive performance against 2-bit PTQ methods with lower memory cost while accelerating both prefill and decoding for end-to-end speedup.

papers.title: PTQ4ARVG: Post-Training Quantization for AutoRegressive Visual Generation Models
papers.contribution: Effectively quantizes ARVG models to 8-bit and 6-bit while maintaining competitive performance without training.

papers.title: Parallel Token Generation for Language Models
papers.contribution: Distilled models match teacher output for ~50 tokens on toy data and 5 tokens on coding within one forward pass, enabling parallel generation without sacrificing expressiveness.

papers.title: Partial Fusion of Neural Networks: Efficient Tradeoffs Between Ensembles and Weight Aggregation
papers.contribution: Enables flexible cost-performance trade-offs between computational efficiency and accuracy, with generalized pruning on single networks yielding similar benefits to partial fusion.

papers.title: PatternKV: Flattening KV Representation Expands Quantization Headroom
papers.contribution: Delivers consistent 2-bit gains, incurs 0.08% average 4-bit drop relative to FP16, raises throughput by 1.5x, and improves test-time scaling accuracy by 10% on average.

papers.title: Post-Training Quantization for Video Matting
papers.contribution: Achieves near full-precision performance under ultra-low-bit quantization for video matting models, reducing error of existing PTQ methods up to 20%.

papers.title: Precision-Induced Miscalibration: Understanding and Correcting Confidence Distortion in Quantized Neural Networks
papers.contribution: On ImageNet with mixed-precision ResNet-50, PACS reduces Expected Calibration Error from 5.82% to 1.92% while maintaining accuracy.

papers.title: Preserve-Then-Quantize: Balancing Rank Budgets for Quantization Error Reconstruction in LLMs
papers.contribution: Achieves consistent perplexity reductions across diverse models with 5.9 percentage-point average gain on GLUE under 2-bit QPEFT.

papers.title: Principled SVD-based Delta Compression via Quantization Error Minimization
papers.contribution: PrinMix outperforms SOTA Delta-CoMe by 22.3% on AIME2024 and 6.1% on GQA for 7B LLM compression.

papers.title: Prism-MoE: Efficient Dense-to-MoE Conversion for Visual Autoregressive Generation
papers.contribution: Achieves dense-to-MoE conversion with less than 10% of standard training budget while maintaining quality with only 37.5% active parameters.

papers.title: ProjQ: Project-and-Quantize for Adapter-Aware LLM Compression
papers.contribution: ProjQ achieves up to 2x lower evaluation loss for compensation compared to standard PTQ and matches the performance of standard 4-bit baselines on language modeling with only 3 bits.

papers.title: Proteus: Lookup-Free Trellis-Coded Quantization by Lattice-Breaking Compute Codes for 2-Bit LLMs
papers.contribution: Improves perplexity and accuracy on Llama 2 at 2-bit PTQ while reducing decode bandwidth (e.g., 740 vs 1020 GB/s on 70B).

papers.title: Prune Redundancy, Preserve Essence: Vision Token Compression in VLMs via Synergistic Importance-Diversity
papers.contribution: Achieves 96.3% accuracy on LLaVA-1.5 with 11.1% token retention and 92.8% on LLaVA-NeXT at 5.6% retention; 7.8x faster prefilling with 2.5% better accuracy than prior methods.

papers.title: Prune-then-Quantize or Quantize-then-Prune? Understanding the Impact of Compression Order in Joint Model Compression
papers.contribution: Shows relative benefit of compression order increases with underlying performance gap; validates hypothesis across language and vision models and multi-stage compression scenarios.

papers.title: Pruning as a Cooperative Game: Surrogate-Assisted Layer Contribution Estimation for Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Demonstrates consistent superiority in perplexity and zero-shot accuracy, achieving more efficient and effective layer-wise pruning.

papers.title: PsumQuant: In-line Post-training Partial Sum Quantizer for Energy Efficient NPU Inference
papers.contribution: Compresses partial sum precision to 8-bit with only 1% accuracy drop on ResNet-18 and 0.04 perplexity increase on Llama-3.1, achieving 45% total energy reduction.

papers.title: Pushing the Limits of Block Rotations in Post-Training Quantization
papers.contribution: The method recovers up to 90% of full-vector rotation perplexity when quantizing Llama3 1B to INT4 with block size 16, compared to 46% without permutations.

papers.title: Q&C: When Quantization Meets Cache in Efficient Generation
papers.contribution: The hybrid method achieves up to 12.7x acceleration across diverse generation tasks while preserving generation quality.

papers.title: Q-DiT4SR: Exploration of Detail-Preserving Diffusion Transformer Quantization for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance under W4A6 and W4A4 settings with 5.8× model size reduction and 6.14× computational operation reduction.

papers.title: Q-Sched: Pushing the Boundaries of Few-Step Diffusion Models with Quantization-Aware Scheduling
papers.contribution: Q-Sched delivers 4× model size reduction with 15.5% FID improvement over FP16 4-step LCM and 16.6% over FP16 8-step PCM, validated by 80,000+ user annotations.

papers.title: Qronos: Correcting the Past by Shaping the Future... in Post-Training Quantization
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms adaptive rounding methods on Llama3 and Qwen3 families when quantizing weights, activations, and KV caches to 4 bits or fewer.

papers.title: QuRL: Low-Precision Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Reasoning
papers.contribution: QuRL achieves 20% to 80% faster rollout during RL training with INT8 and FP8 quantization without training collapse.

papers.title: Quant-dLLM: Post-Training Extreme Low-Bit Quantization for Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Achieves higher accuracy than state-of-the-art AR-transfer PTQ methods on dLLMs at 2-bit precision.

papers.title: Quantized Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer
papers.contribution: Achieves 3.7× memory reduction and 2.5× acceleration in real hardware inference while preserving over 98% reconstruction quality.

papers.title: Quartet II: Accurate LLM Pre-Training in NVFP4 by Improved Unbiased Gradient Estimation
papers.contribution: Quartet II achieves consistently better gradient estimation and delivers up to 4.2x speedup on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs for end-to-end LLM training.

papers.title: RCPU: Rotation-Constrained Error Compensation for Structured Pruning of a Large Language Model
papers.contribution: RCPU effectively compensates pruning errors on Llama-7B and Llama-2-13B across WikiText-2 and language understanding benchmarks while maintaining semantic structure.

papers.title: REAP the Experts: Why Pruning Prevails for One-Shot MoE compression
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms merging methods on generative benchmarks at 50% compression, achieving near-lossless compression on code generation tasks.

papers.title: RTPrune: Reading-Twice Inspired Token Pruning for Efficient DeepSeek-OCR Inference
papers.contribution: Achieves 99.47% accuracy and 1.23× faster prefill on OmniDocBench with 84.25% token retention for DeepSeek-OCR-Large.

papers.title: RaBiT: Residual Aware Binarization Training for Accurate and Efficient LLMs
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art 2-bit accuracy while rivals hardware-intensive Vector Quantization and delivers 4.49x inference speedup on RTX 4090.

papers.title: RaBitQCache: Rotated Binary Quantization for KVCache in Long Context LLM Inference
papers.contribution: Significantly accelerates inference and reduces memory I/O while preserving generation quality compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

papers.title: Rank-Aware Spectral Bounds on Attention Logits for Stable Low-Precision Training
papers.contribution: Achieves 8-28x tighter concentration bounds; eliminates overflows in FP8 training across GPT-2 XL to Llama-2-70B while maintaining accuracy.

papers.title: ReQAT: Achieving Full-Precision Reasoning Accuracy with 4-bit Floating-Point Quantization-Aware Training
papers.contribution: Recovers and surpasses BF16 accuracy under same training budget while delivering up to 3.9x throughput speedup on NVIDIA DGX Spark and 3.1x on B200.

papers.title: ReSpinQuant: Efficient Layer-Wise LLM Quantization via Subspace Residual Rotation Approximation
papers.contribution: ReSpinQuant achieves state-of-the-art performance on W4A4 and W3A3 quantization, outperforming global rotation methods while matching expensive layer-wise methods with minimal overhead.

papers.title: Reasoning Models Can be Accurately Pruned Via Chain-of-Thought Reconstruction
papers.contribution: RAC significantly boosts pruning performance for reasoning models with integrated drop-in fix.

papers.title: Reasoning-preserved Efficient Distillation of Large Language Models via Activation-aware Initialization
papers.contribution: RED substantially recovers reasoning ability while maintaining high training efficiency and state-of-the-art general ability on Llama and Qwen series.

papers.title: Rethinking 1-bit Optimization Leveraging Pre-trained Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Achieves high-performance 1-bit LLMs from pre-trained models across various sizes without expensive training from scratch.

papers.title: Rethinking Depth Pruning for Vision Transformers: A Heterogeneity-Aware Perspective
papers.contribution: Achieves 1.58x speedup for DeiT-B with accuracy maintenance and 5.19x extreme pruning speedup when combined with width pruning.

papers.title: RobuQ: Pushing DiTs to W1.58A2 via Robust Activation Quantization
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art image generation with activations quantized to an average of 2 bits on ImageNet-1K, representing the first stable deployment at W1.58A2.

papers.title: Robust Training of Neural Networks at Arbitrary Precision and Sparsity
papers.contribution: The unified framework trains models at arbitrary precisions and sparsity levels with state-of-the-art results including stable A1W1 and sub-1-bit networks, mapping efficiency frontiers for modern LLMs.

papers.title: S-Quant: Rethinking Weight Quantization with Seed-Based Generation
papers.contribution: S-Quant achieves state-of-the-art performance at 3-4 bit weights and enables a 4x speedup via a custom ASIC accelerator for memory-bound LLM inference.

papers.title: SALE : Low-bit Estimation for Efficient Sparse Attention in Long-context LLM Prefilling
papers.contribution: SALE achieves at least 3.36x speedups on Llama-3.1-8B for sequences longer than 64K with negligible accuracy loss, requiring no training and seamless integration.

papers.title: SCHUR-A*: Layer-wise Optimal Expert Pruning for MoEs via Schur-Complement Guided A* Search
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms greedy and ranking-based baselines on Qwen3-30B-A3B, maintaining comparable performance under aggressive pruning.

papers.title: SERQ: Saliency-Aware Low-Rank Error Reconstruction for LLM Quantization
papers.contribution: Enables efficient 4-bit matrix multiplication while keeping latency overhead minimal through offline processing.

papers.title: SHARP-Q: Spectral Hessian Alignment and Rectification for Post-training Quantization
papers.contribution: SHARP-Q establishes state-of-the-art results on W2A2 and W3A3 settings across convolutional networks, Vision Transformers, and State Space Models, enabling uniform quantizers to outperform specialized non-uniform designs.

papers.title: SINQ: Sinkhorn-Normalized Quantization for Calibration-Free Low-Precision LLM Weights
papers.contribution: Reduces WikiText2 and C4 perplexity gap by over 50% against uncalibrated baselines with zero to negligible compute overhead.

papers.title: SNaX: sparse narrow accelerated mixture of experts
papers.contribution: Reduces activation memory by 45% and achieves 1.80x throughput improvement on H100 GPUs compared to ScatterMoE for 7B models, reaching 213B tokens/day on 64 H100s.

papers.title: SPR$^2$Q: Static Priority-based Rectifier Routing Quantization for Image Super-Resolution
papers.contribution: SPR2Q achieves 0.55 dB and 1.31 dB PSNR improvements on Set5 under 4-bit and 2-bit settings respectively, outperforming state-of-the-art.

papers.title: SSDi8: Accurate and Efficient 8-bit Quantization for State Space Duality
papers.contribution: Achieves accuracy comparable to FP16 with up to 1.4X speedup in W4A8 and W8A8 settings, with robustness validated on resource-constrained Orin Nano device.

papers.title: STAR-KV: Low-Rank KV Cache Compression via Soft Thresholding for Adaptive Rank Control
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 75% KV cache compression and 20x overall reduction with quantization, delivering up to 6.9x attention module speedup and 3.1x end-to-end generation throughput.

papers.title: STLA: Spatiotemporal Lookahead Alignment for Post-Training Quantization
papers.contribution: Establishes state-of-the-art for low-bit PTQ while maintaining computational efficiency.

papers.title: STaMP: Sequence Transformation and Mixed Precision for Low-Precision Activation Quantization
papers.contribution: Significantly improve low bit-width activation quantization on recent LVM and LLM architectures, complementing existing quantization methods.

papers.title: Saliency-Aware Model Merging
papers.contribution: Reduces the gap between data-free and test-time adaptation methods, with rank-wise decomposition supporting LoRA merging without compromising structure.

papers.title: Scaling Law for Quantization-Aware Training
papers.contribution: Through 268 experiments shows quantization error decreases with model size but increases with tokens and coarser granularity; identifies activation outliers in FC2 as bottleneck.

papers.title: Selective Coupling of Decoupled Informative Regions: Masked Attention Alignment for Data-Free Quantization of Vision Transformers
papers.contribution: Aligns full-precision models with quantized models while preserving mutual information with synthetic samples across multiple ViT backbones.

papers.title: Self-Guidance: Enhancing Neural Codecs via Decoder Manifold Alignment
papers.contribution: Self-guidance improves all reconstruction metrics on XCodec2, enables 4x codebook reduction without fidelity loss, and significantly improves downstream LLM-based synthesis.

papers.title: Semantic Cache Distillation: Efficient State Transfer via Reuse and Selective Patching
papers.contribution: Deliver up to 2.65× TTFT speedup over oracle consumer prefill while keeping generation quality within 5% F1.

papers.title: Sign Lock-In: Randomly Initialized Weight Signs Persist and Bottleneck Sub-Bit Model Compression
papers.contribution: Introduces from-scratch low-rank sign-template training method that prevents emergence of the one-bit wall bottleneck in sub-bit compression.

papers.title: Skip-It? Theoretical Conditions for Layer Skipping in Vision–Language Models
papers.contribution: Validates that early and late vision tokens are redundant; framework provides theoretically grounded understanding unifying modern layer-skipping techniques.

papers.title: SlideSparse: Fast and Flexible (2N-2):2N Structured Sparsity
papers.contribution: 1.33× speedup matches theoretical upper-bound N/(N-1)=4/3 at 6:8 sparsity; enables better accuracy-speedup tradeoffs for LLM acceleration.

papers.title: SliderQuant: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for LLMs
papers.contribution: Significantly reduces quantization errors across layers, improving LLM quantization quality at challenging bit-widths.

papers.title: SparseSSM: Efficient Selective Structured State Space Models Can Be Pruned in One-Shot
papers.contribution: Achieves current state-of-the-art one-shot pruning for Mamba-based LLMs, pruning 50% of weights without fine-tuning with only limited performance degradation.

papers.title: Spatial-Aware Reduction Framework: Towards Efficient and Faithful Visual State Space Models
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art training-free pruning with up to 63.3% accuracy recovery on VMamba; incurs only 1.0% drop on PlainMamba with performance comparable to ViT.

papers.title: SubspacePath Pruner: Inference-time Pruning via Probe-based Representation–Parameter Coupling
papers.contribution: Achieves 29.3 average Recall on cross-domain tests and 1.27x speedup at 30% pruning on LLaMA-2-13B with inference-time specialization.

papers.title: SumRA: Parameter Efficient Fine-tuning with Singular Value Decomposition and Summed Orthogonal Basis
papers.contribution: Improves word error rate on multilingual ASR from 14.42% to 12.41% over LoRA with 50% fewer trainable parameters.

papers.title: TWLA: Achieving Ternary Weights and Low-Bit Activations for LLMs via Post-Training Quantization
papers.contribution: Achieves 1.58-bit weight compression and 4-bit activation quantization (W1.58A4 configuration) while maintaining high accuracy.

papers.title: Tequila: Deadzone-free Ternary Quantization for Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Tequila achieves >4% accuracy gain over state-of-the-art ternary quantization methods on ARC benchmark, nearly matching full-precision performance with 3.0x inference speedup.

papers.title: TetraJet-v2: Accurate NVFP4 Training for Large Language Models with Oscillation Suppression and Outlier Control
papers.contribution: Outperforms prior FP4 methods up to 370M parameters, reducing FP8 performance gap by 51.3% on average with 1.67x speedup.

papers.title: The Geometry of LLM Quantization: GPTQ as Babai's Nearest Plane Algorithm
papers.contribution: Provides geometric interpretation of GPTQ error propagation and designs post-training quantization methods avoiding clipping that outperform original GPTQ while providing efficient GPU inference kernels.

papers.title: The Lattice Geometry of Neural Network Quantization: A Short Equivalence Proof of GPTQ and Babai's Algorithm
papers.contribution: Provides geometric intuition for quantization algorithms and hints at possibility of using lattice basis reduction for improved quantization.

papers.title: The Unseen Frontier: Pushing the Limits of LLM Sparsity with Surrogate-Free ADMM
papers.contribution: Achieves 7.8x less perplexity than best existing method on LLaMA-2-7B at 90% sparsity and enables 3.98x inference speedup with 7.80x memory compression.

papers.title: ThinKV: Thought-Adaptive KV Cache Compression for Efficient Reasoning Models
papers.contribution: Achieves near-lossless accuracy with less than 5% of original KV cache and up to 5.8x higher inference throughput.

papers.title: TileQ: Efficient Low-Rank Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts with 2D Tiling
papers.contribution: Cuts memory usage by up to 10x and reduces inference latency to 5% while preserving state-of-the-art accuracy.

papers.title: TileSparse: Arithmetic-Intensity-Aware Sparse Attention for Compute-Bound LLM Decoding
papers.contribution: Improves accuracy by 40% over dynamic K-only methods under tight budgets and preserves 99% full-attention accuracy while cutting compute by 40.8%.

papers.title: To Compress or Not? Pushing the Frontier of Lossless GenAI Model Weights Compression with Exponent Concentration
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 26.9% memory savings and 177.1% throughput acceleration with perfectly lossless computations on LLMs and DiTs up to 671B parameters.

papers.title: ToaSt: Token Channel Selection and Structured Pruning for Efficient ViT
papers.contribution: On ViT-MAE-Huge, ToaSt achieves 88.52% accuracy (1.64 percentage points improvement) with 39.4% FLOPs reduction and transfers effectively to downstream tasks including COCO detection and ADE20K segmentation.

papers.title: Towards Resource-Efficient LLMs: End-to-End Energy Accounting of Distillation Pipelines
papers.contribution: Reveals previously ignored teacher-side costs and derives practical design rules for selecting distillation methods under energy constraints.

papers.title: Training Dynamics Impact Post-Training Quantization Robustness
papers.contribution: Shows validation loss and quantization error diverge after learning rate decay independent of scale; strategic hyperparameter interventions improve quantization quality.

papers.title: TurboBoA: Faster and Exact Attention-aware Quantization without Backpropagation
papers.contribution: Delivers more than three-fold speedup over BoA while consistently improving accuracy; achieves state-of-the-art results in weight-only and weight-activation quantization.

papers.title: TwinQuant: Learnable Subspace Decomposition for 4-Bit LLM Quantization
papers.contribution: TwinQuant preserves near-FP16 accuracy across LLaMA3 and Qwen3 models and delivers up to 1.8× end-to-end speedup over FP16 baseline.

papers.title: Two-Stage Unit Tying for Simplifying Differentiable Logic Gate Networks
papers.contribution: Yields substantial post-synthesis LUT reductions of up to 48% on CIFAR-10 and 43% on MNIST with modest accuracy degradation.

papers.title: Two-dimensional quantization for geometry-aware audio coding
papers.contribution: Improves audio compression efficiency with low token rates and high codebook utilization while maintaining state-of-the-art reconstruction quality.

papers.title: Ultrafast On-Chip Online Learning via Spline Locality in Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks
papers.contribution: Demonstrates significantly more efficient and expressive KAN-based online learners than MLPs for low-latency tasks, achieving model-free learning at sub-microsecond latencies.

papers.title: Understanding Performance Collapse in Layer-Pruned Large Language Models via Decision Representation Transitions
papers.contribution: Shows pruning Decisive Phase has minimal impact but Silent Phase pruning triggers immediate collapse, revealing extreme sensitivity of decision transition.

papers.title: UniQL: Unified Quantization and Low-rank Compression for Adaptive Edge LLMs
papers.contribution: Achieves 4x–5.7x memory reduction and 2.7x–3.4x token throughput improvement at 15% pruning across diverse architectures while maintaining accuracy within 5%.

papers.title: UniSVQ: 2-bit Unified Scalar-Vector Quantization
papers.contribution: UniSVQ outperforms state-of-the-art scalar quantization methods and achieves performance comparable to advanced vector quantization while providing higher inference throughput.

papers.title: UniSparse: Combining Weight Pruning and Spike Sparsification in Spiking Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art energy-accuracy trade-off; a sparsified ResNet-18 requires only 7.04M SOPs to reach 92.38% accuracy on CIFAR-10.

papers.title: Unveiling the Potential of Quantization with MXFP4: Strategies for Quantization Error Reduction
papers.contribution: OAS and MBS reduce accuracy gap between MXFP4 and NVFP4 from ~10% to below 1% on average while incurring only 6.2% GEMM overhead.

papers.title: VEQ: Modality-Adaptive Quantization for MoE Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Under W3A16 configuration, achieves significant average accuracy gains of 2.04% on Kimi-VL and 3.09% on Qwen3-VL compared to previous SOTA quantization methods.

papers.title: VQ-Transplant: Efficient VQ-Module Integration for Pre-trained Visual Tokenizers
papers.contribution: VQ-Transplant achieves near state-of-the-art reconstruction fidelity while reducing training cost by 95% compared to full retraining.

papers.title: Video-SVD: Efficient Video Diffusion via Orthogonal Basis Composition
papers.contribution: Achieves 1.92x speedup on HunyuanVideo and 1.75-1.79x on Wan2.1 models while maintaining high visual quality.

papers.title: WINA: Weight Informed Neuron Activation for Accelerating Large Language Model Inference
papers.contribution: WINA matches or exceeds prior training-free methods at comparable sparsity and sustains performance better at extreme sparsity levels across diverse LLM architectures.

papers.title: WaterSIC: Information-Theoretically (Near) Optimal \\Linear Layer Quantization
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance for quantization rates 1 to 4 bits on Llama and Qwen LLMs while staying near the information-theoretic limit.

papers.title: What Layers When: Learning to Skip Compute in LLMs with Residual Gates
papers.contribution: Saves up to 15% compute while retaining >90% accuracy on long-form reasoning, with stable fine-tuning on pretrained models.

papers.title: Which Heads Matter for Reasoning? RL-Guided KV Cache Compression
papers.contribution: Enables 20-60% cache reduction with near-lossless performance and up to 2.06x end-to-end speedup at 60% reduction across diverse tasks.

papers.title: WildCat: Near-Linear Attention in Theory and Practice
papers.contribution: Achieves super-polynomial error decay O(n^(-sqrt(log(log(n))))) with near-linear O(n^(1+o(1))) runtime while preserving 99% full-attention accuracy and cutting compute by 40.8%.

papers.title: WinQ: Accelerating Quantization-Aware Training of Language Models Around Saddle Points
papers.contribution: Accelerates QAT by up to 4x across quantization methods and models, improving state-of-the-art sub-4-bit quantization by up to 8.8%.

papers.title: XSpecMesh: Quality-Preserving Auto-Regressive Mesh Generation Acceleration via Multi-Head Speculative Decoding
papers.contribution: XSpecMesh achieves 1.7× speedup for auto-regressive mesh generation without sacrificing generation quality.

papers.title: Zeros can be Informative: Masked Binary U-Net for Image Segmentation on Tensor Cores
papers.contribution: Attains near full-precision accuracy on segmentation benchmarks while achieving near-binary efficiency on widely available GPUs.
